boundary: Family-scoped S4 query and sentinel development for open-index discovery only; not a frozen systematic search, eligibility decision, or PRISMA input.

queries.query: large language model AI assisted code review pull request human reviewer workload attention effort verification
+("large language model" | LLM | "generative AI" | "AI-assisted") +("code review" | "pull request") +(human | reviewer | workload | attention | effort | verification)

sentinels.title: Same Scrutiny, More Time: Eye Tracking Insights into Reviewing LLM-Labelled Code
sentinels.rationale: Direct behavioral evidence about review time and attention when code is labelled as LLM-generated.

sentinels.title: Automated Code Review In Practice
sentinels.rationale: Industrial evidence linking automated LLM review to acted-on feedback, perceived quality benefits, and longer pull-request closure duration.

sentinels.title: From Human-Centric to Agentic Code Review: The Impact of Different Generations of Generative AI Technology on Review Quality
sentinels.rationale: In-scope evidence of faster review decisions in some agent-involved patterns while finding no consistent joint efficiency-and-quality superiority; constrains a one-directional burden thesis.

sentinels.title: Modern Code Review: A Case Study at Google
sentinels.rationale: Foundational non-LLM code-review evidence; retrieval is a precision warning, while absence is not evidence against the framework.
